description: In the HEC-RAS Muncie project, the geometry preprocessor input file (Muncie.x04) is currently open in the text editor. This file contains cross-section data for the White River in Muncie, Indiana. Manning's roughness coefficients are defined in sections labeled 'Section - XS Manning's/Roughness Data'. Each roughness data line specifies zone boundaries and n-values for left overbank, main channel, and right overbank. Your task is to locate the FIRST cross-section's Manning's roughness data and increase the main channel n-value (the middle roughness coefficient on the data line following the section header) from its current value to 0.05, representing increased channel roughness due to vegetation growth. Be careful to only modify the Manning's roughness coefficient in the correct roughness section — the file contains many numeric values for geometry coordinates and other parameters that must not be changed. Save the file after making the edit.
